verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only environment separation for secret keys (sk_test_ vs sk_live_) and roles and permissions for human team members. Neither is a documented way to issue API credentials limited to specific permissions or resources for an agent. Environment separation is an adjacent control, and team-member roles are a different feature, so neither earns credit toward least-privilege API credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
